                <span class="module-beat-num">02 / GATHERINGS</span>
                <h1>Taste Gatherings</h1>
                <p>Prefer a smaller social way to meet? Start with a shared Taste — coffee circles, food walks, and other labelled examples until they are real.</p>
              </div>
              <div class="module-beat-photo">
                <img
                  src="/media/elaris-gatherings-cafe.png"

                  height="880"

              </div>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="step-body">
        <div class="shell">
          <h2>Inside this chapter</h2>
          <p class="section-lede">
            Grouped by compatible age band, geography, intent and the purpose of the gathering. Taste is a context signal, not the only admission rule. We do not promise romance from an event.
          </p>

          <div class="principle-row">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

              </svg>
            </div>
            <div class="principle-copy">
              <h3>Same network. Another way to cross paths.</h3>
              <p>
                A gathering is an activation of the local singles network — not a separate product. Published only when host, venue, capacity and a safety owner are real.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="principle-row reverse">
            <div class="principle-icon" aria-hidden="true">

              <p>
                Visible host. No forced pairings. Photo consent before pictures. Prefer recommended public places and partner venues where available.

              <h3>Taste as context, not a score</h3>
              <p>
                Shared interests, energy and lifestyle help us group people. Enough signal to meet well — never a compatibility percentage.
